Suriya's Scene has crossed ₹200 crore worldwide in six days, its makers say. Zhagaram Studios, Suriya's own production banner, put the total at ₹205 crore on Wednesday, 11 November; box office tracker Sacnilk counted ₹188.5 crore the same day.

If the makers' figure holds, Scene is Suriya's third ₹200 crore film of 2026, after Karuppu (₹310 crore) and Vishwanath & Sons (₹209.5 crore). Trade reports say no Tamil actor has had three in one year before. Jithu Madhavan's film opened in cinemas on 6 November.

Which of Suriya's three films this year did you watch in a theatre?
